description: Search currently open job listings on emprego.com — jobs in many countries and languages. Returns title, company, location, work model, salary when known, and the canonical URL to apply. Where the employer states a salary in a country with a supported tax model, `netMonthlyEstimate` adds an estimated take-home pay per month (single person, no dependants, from the lower end of the range; hourly and daily rates as a full-time month), with its assumptions in `basis`.

location.description: City, region or country, in any language. E.g. "Lisboa", "Germany", "Brasil".

query.description: Keywords: job title, skill or company, in any language. E.g. "nurse", "enfermeiro".

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
